Terms of use

The terms that apply when you use the app.

What changed. Corrected the purchase section to reflect that the app is free and has no in-app purchases; removed remaining purchase-check and paid-feature wording.

Invoice Creator is made by KLM Labs. These terms describe the agreement between you and KLM Labs when you use the app. Please also read the Privacy Policy, which explains that your invoice and client data stays on your device.

On iPhone and iPad, Apple's standard licence also applies

Where Invoice Creator is downloaded from the Apple App Store, it is licensed to you under Apple's Standard End User Licence Agreement, in addition to these terms. Where the two conflict on a point Apple's licence covers, Apple's licence governs.

What you may do with the app

You get a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable licence to use Invoice Creator on devices you own or control, for your own business or personal invoicing. You may use the invoices, estimates and PDFs you create for any lawful purpose, including commercially — they are your documents, not ours.

You may not resell, rent or redistribute the app itself, or use it to create documents that are fraudulent or unlawful.

Free to use

Invoice Creator is free to use and sells nothing inside the app. If paid features are added in the future, these terms will be updated before those features launch.

Your data is yours, and it lives on your device

Invoice Creator stores your business details, clients, invoices and estimates locally on your device. We do not hold a copy, so we cannot recover your data for you if the device is lost, reset, or the app is uninstalled. Keep your own copies of anything you need — exported PDFs are stored wherever you choose to share or save them.

You are responsible for the accuracy of what you put on an invoice, including tax rates, totals and client details. The app performs the arithmetic you ask it to; it does not give tax, accounting or legal advice, and it is not a substitute for an accountant.

Availability and changes

We may update the app, change or remove features, or stop distributing it.

We may update these terms. The effective date above shows when they last changed, and continuing to use the app after a change means you accept the updated terms.

No warranty, and the limit of our liability

Invoice Creator is provided "as is". To the extent the law allows, we do not warrant that it will be uninterrupted, error-free, or fit for a particular purpose, and we exclude implied warranties.

To the extent the law allows, KLM Labs is not liable for indirect or consequential loss, including lost profits, lost business, or loss of data. Where liability cannot be excluded, it is limited to the amount you paid for the app in the twelve months before the claim.

Nothing here removes rights you have under consumer law in your country, including any statutory right to a refund or remedy. If a term conflicts with a consumer right you have, that right wins.
